messages:
Hannah (CSM): Heads-up: Skyline QBR scheduled Mon 11am PT. Need final 12-slide deck + 1-pg post-QBR followup plan by Sun 6pm PT. High-level asks below.

Hannah (CSM): Please cover: account health (usage + errors), onboarding progress, renewal posture & risk plan, enablement assets, and a clear owner for each open feedback item.

Olek (CS Ops): I'll run the health metrics. Plan: MAU trend, avg latency, top 3 errors last 30d. Which NPS source do we reference? CSAT or product NPS? :question:

Priya (AE): Use CSAT for operational items and product NPS for exec sentiment. Renewal note: sponsor gave mixed signals last call. I'll draft mitigation (exec follow-up + 2-week integration sprint). Risk score tentative: 42%.

Jules (Enablement): I'll produce a 7-min enablement clip focusing on admin onboarding and billing reconciliation. Office hours Fri 10am PT. Recording + 1-page checklist to drop in drive.

Rina (SE): For onboarding blockers, I'll run these two quick queries and paste results:
```sql
-- adoption by module
SELECT module, active_users, pct_started, pct_completed
FROM module_adoption
WHERE account = 'skyline'
ORDER BY pct_completed DESC;

-- recent errors by endpoint
SELECT endpoint, count(*) as failures
FROM error_logs
WHERE account = 'skyline' AND ts > now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY endpoint
ORDER BY failures DESC;
```
I'll attach CSVs and a 1-slide PNG.

Hannah (CSM): Action items (reply with DONE when complete):
- Olek: Health slide with MAU, latency, top errors + NPS source call (due Sun 6pm)
- Rina: Adoption queries + PNG slide (due Sat EOD)
- Jules: Enablement clip + checklist (due Sun 6pm)
- Priya: Renewal mitigation slide + sponsor touch plan (due Sun 6pm)
- Hannah: One-page followup plan + exec bullets (due Sun 6pm)

Priya (AE): Quick ask: can SEs add a small screenshot of the new routing perf dashboard? That helped on last call.

Rina (SE): Will export perf-snapshot.png to /drive/skyline/qbr/assets. Also will anonymize any customer quotes.

Olek (CS Ops): Capturing feedback owners: billing -> Priya, API docs -> Rina, onboarding UX -> Jules. Will add to "open asks" slide with owners and ETA.

reminder-bot: Upload reminder set for Sun 18:00 PT. Final deck snapshot will be taken then.

Hannah (CSM): Thanks team — if we complete these by Sun we should be able to reduce the risk and provide a crisp ask to the sponsor. Ping if blocked. :pray:
